objective: Prevent derived current claims from silently laundering stale/planned inputs into present-tense calculations, while preserving useful calculation when all required current inputs are verified and preserving lean/proportional reasoning.

roles_before.artifact: PROTOCOL.md resolves claims by claim class -> authority -> event time/provenance and distinguishes planned/prefilled/scheduled state from real-world execution.
PROTOCOL.md permits calculations and plans from owner/live evidence but currently lacks an explicit inheritance rule for mixed-provenance derived claims.
PROTOCOL.md keeps reasoning lean and stops when added analysis cannot change the decision.
Exact domain/live owners remain authoritative for mutable facts; the optimizer/protocol do not create a second current-state owner.
Git history plus dated stress-test evidence preserve the pre-fix behavior and the repeated failure class.
.github/workflows/continuity-guard.yml executes architecture and total-value regression guards.

role_dispositions.destination: Add one compact derived-provenance rule: a current derived claim cannot be stronger than its material inputs, and missing current inputs cannot be silently filled from stale/planned values.
Calculations with unverified material current inputs must remain UNKNOWN, conditional, threshold-based, or range-bounded until the missing input is verified.
The new rule does not require extra retrieval when the unknown cannot change the action; it only forbids silently treating stale/planned data as current.
No new owner is created and current mutable facts still come from their exact owner/live source.
Git history and the 2026-09-20 novel/targeted stress evidence remain recoverable.
Continuity CI will add a focused deterministic guard for the derived-provenance rule and its contra case.

capability_probes.assertion: When all material current inputs are verified, the system must still calculate normally instead of refusing or returning UNKNOWN.
If current end time/commute are observed but start time exists only in a stale Calendar plan, the system must not compute current weekly workload by borrowing that stale start time.
Finance, schedule, mobility, health and other mutable claims must still route to their exact owners/live sources; no generic provenance layer may replace them.
The pre-fix protocol and both 2026-09-20 stress results remain recoverable through Git history/tests.

tests.expected: PASS: protocol carries the mixed-provenance inheritance rule and regression cases encode both missing-input refusal and verified-input calculation.

tests.command: python tests/architecture_change_guard.py && python tests/architecture_change_guard_selftest.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard.py && python tests/continuity_coverage_guard_selftest.py && python tests/total_value_optimizer_guard.py

verification.behavioral_status: Two production probes reproduced the same stale/planned input laundering defect. Candidate deterministic tests will protect the rule surface; a fresh ordinary-chat replay after promotion remains the behavioral confirmation step.
verification.candidate_implementation: One compact PROTOCOL rule, one focused deterministic guard, one frozen behavioral regression spec, and one continuity-CI step; no owner/routing/live-source mutation.
